description: This file contains utility functions for handling workflow actions, templates, and triggers in a notification system, including functions for determining action types, selecting templates, and processing event IDs.

methods.name: shouldScheduleEmailReminder
methods.description: Determines if an email reminder should be scheduled based on the action type.

methods.name: shouldScheduleSMSReminder
methods.description: Determines if an SMS reminder should be scheduled based on the action type.

methods.name: isSMSAction
methods.description: Checks if the action is an SMS type.

methods.name: isWhatsappAction
methods.description: Checks if the action is a WhatsApp type.

methods.name: isSMSOrWhatsappAction
methods.description: Checks if the action is either SMS or WhatsApp.

methods.name: isCalAIAction
methods.description: Checks if the action is a Cal AI phone call.

methods.name: isEmailAction
methods.description: Checks if the action is an email type.

methods.name: isAttendeeAction
methods.description: Checks if the action targets an attendee.

methods.name: isEmailToAttendeeAction
methods.description: Checks if the action is an email to attendee.

methods.name: isTextMessageToSpecificNumber
methods.description: Checks if the action is a text message to a specific number.

methods.name: getWhatsappTemplateForTrigger
methods.description: Returns the WhatsApp template based on trigger event.

methods.name: getWhatsappTemplateFunction
methods.description: Returns the template function for WhatsApp based on template type.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateFunction
methods.description: Returns the template function for email based on template type.

methods.name: getWhatsappTemplateForAction
methods.description: Gets the WhatsApp message template for a specific action.

methods.name: getTemplateBodyForAction
methods.description: Generates message body for an action, whether SMS, WhatsApp, or email.

methods.name: getTemplateSubjectForAction
methods.description: Gets the email subject for an email action.

methods.name: isFormTrigger
methods.description: Checks if a trigger is a form submission.

methods.name: hasCalAIAction
methods.description: Checks if any step contains a Cal AI action.

methods.name: getEventTypeIdForCalAiTest
methods.description: Determines event type ID and error message for Cal AI test based on trigger and event IDs.
